en.title: Buying a groupset for a frame build: count parts before counting savings
en.description: Decode groupset package contents, avoid counting parts twice, and prepare a compatibility checklist before buying drivetrain and brakes for a frameset.
en.intro: A groupset deal can look complete while leaving out the part that makes the whole system work. Package labels are shorthand. The itemized contents are the purchase.

sections.heading: Do not translate a package name into assumed contents
paragraphs: Small and large groupset packages are common retail descriptions, but they are not a substitute for an inventory. Ask for exact model codes and quantities for shifters, derailleurs, crankset, bottom bracket, cassette, chain, brake calipers, hoses, rotors, adapters and electronic-system accessories as applicable.

Mark each item as supplied, already owned or still needed. Check whether left and right controls are both present and whether a listed brake is a complete usable assembly or only one component. Confirm what is new, what packaging it comes in and what support the seller provides.
If a package photograph and text disagree, ask the seller to resolve the discrepancy in writing. A photo containing a rotor is not a dependable promise that two matching rotors are in the box.

sections.heading: Check the chain of interfaces
paragraphs: Begin with the frame’s current documentation, then the component manufacturers’ compatibility information. For Shimano, use the [technical-document portal](https://si.shimano.com/en/); for SRAM, use its [service information](https://www.sram.com/en/service). Match actual model codes rather than a family name alone.

Work through bottom bracket and crank spindle, drivetrain generation and speed, freehub and cassette, derailleur mounting, brake mounts and rotors, then routing and cockpit constraints. Unknown should remain an open question for the assembler.

Electronic does not mean accessory-free. Depending on the exact system, batteries, charging equipment, wiring or small mounting parts may still be needed. Ask about the complete system rather than assuming a wireless marketing description covers every connection.

sections.heading: Choose gearing for the ride, then check the combination
paragraphs: Write down your route and load: short fast rides, sustained climbs or luggage change what a useful low gear feels like. Compare a proposed setup with one you have ridden, then have the exact chainring, cassette and derailleur combination checked against the manufacturer’s limits.

Do not assume that adding a larger cassette later is a free adjustment. It may affect the permitted derailleur setup and other parts. Likewise, choose crank length as a fit decision, not simply whichever option is discounted.

Ask the workshop for an assembly quote covering routing, cutting and finishing only after it has seen the component list. Installation requirements differ; generic internet torque values are not a replacement for the exact manual.

sections.heading: Count each part once
paragraphs: The [frameset-versus-complete-bike example](/blog/frameset-vs-complete-bike-cost-in-china/) shows why package contents matter: adding brakes or a cassette again after a package already includes them inflates the build total. Leaving required accessories out makes the total falsely low.

Compare the finished build with a specific complete-bike configuration. The Twitter build pictured here is a complete-bike reference, not a parts list to transfer wholesale to another frame. If you change wheels, gearing or cockpit, update both the cost and the comparison.
Buy when the inventory and interface questions are answered, with a plan for the remaining parts. The best groupset saving is one that survives the mechanic opening every bag.

zh-Hans.title: 自组车怎么买套件：先数部件，再算省钱
zh-Hans.description: 拆解套件套餐内容，避免重复计费，并在购买传动和刹车前建立车架兼容核对清单。
zh-Hans.intro: 套件优惠看似完整，却可能缺少让系统工作的关键部件。套餐名称只是简称，真正买到的是逐项清单。

sections.heading: 别把套餐名称直接当成内含清单
paragraphs: 小套、大套是常见销售简称，却不能替代装箱清单。按实际系统询问准确型号和数量：手变、前后拨、牙盘、中轴、飞轮、链条、夹器、油管、碟片、转换座及电子系统附件。
把每项标为提供、已有或仍需购买。确认左右控制器是否齐全，所谓“刹车”是可用总成还是某个零件，并核对新品状态、包装和卖家售后。
照片与文字不一致时，请卖家书面澄清。照片里有碟片，不能可靠保证箱里有两片匹配碟片。

sections.heading: 沿接口链逐项核对
paragraphs: 先看车架当前资料，再看部件厂商兼容信息。Shimano 可用[技术资料入口](https://si.shimano.com/en/)，SRAM 可用[服务资料](https://www.sram.com/en/service)。匹配实际型号，别只看系列名称。
依次核对中轴与轴心、传动代际和速别、塔基与飞轮、后拨安装、刹车座与碟片，再看走线和把组限制。未知项应交给装配者确认，而不是默认为可用。
电子不等于无需附件。按具体系统，仍可能需要电池、充电设备、线材或安装小件。要问完整系统，别假设“无线”宣传涵盖所有连接。

sections.heading: 先按骑行选齿比，再确认组合
paragraphs: 写下路线和负载：短途快骑、长爬坡或带行李，会改变对低档的需求。先与自己骑过的方案比较，再按厂家限制核对准确牙盘、飞轮和后拨组合。
别假设以后换更大飞轮只是免费调整，它可能影响允许的后拨搭配和其他部件。曲柄长度同样应按合身选择，不是哪个折扣大就选哪个。
车店看到清单后再报价走线、裁切和装配。系统安装要求不同，通用网络扭矩值不能替代准确手册。

sections.heading: 每个部件只算一次
paragraphs: [车架与整车预算示例](/blog/frameset-vs-complete-bike-cost-in-china/)说明了内含清单的重要性：套件已含刹车或飞轮，又加一次会虚增预算；漏掉必需附件则会虚低。
用完成配置与准确整车版本比较。图中的 Twitter 是整车参考，不是可以整套迁移到别的车架上的配件单。换轮组、齿比或把组，都要更新成本和比较。
清单和接口问题解决，并有剩余配件计划后再买。真正的套件省钱，应当经得起技师把每个袋子打开检查。
